description: Land Acquisition - Thumbowila, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically involves the divestment of two specific land allotments (with detailed descriptions of their locations, boundaries, and extents) that were previously vested in the State. The content focuses entirely on land/property matters, including cadastral mapping, lot numbers, and land boundaries, making it clearly a Land Gazette under Type 4 classification. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the land transaction being authorized, and there are no detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes described.
